mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns; lower rates compress discount rates and increase equity valuations, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 0.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a federal funds rate below 0.5% and unemployment rate above 8% indicates a severe economic downturn with aggressive monetary policy response, which typically precedes a market recovery and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 8%, 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) both show monthly growth above 0.5%, it signals a recovery in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic demand and positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both show monthly growth above 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: The unemployment rate (UNRATE) is positively correlated with negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns; higher unemployment signals deteriorating economic conditions that reduce corporate earnings and increase risk aversion, leading to lower equity prices.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it indicates a severe contraction in the real economy, which typically triggers aggressive monetary policy and market stabilization, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 90, 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 300,000 million dollars and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a deep recession in both the housing market and industrial output, which typically triggers a market recovery and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where RSAFS < 300000 and INDPRO < 90, 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) from the previous quarter signals a recession, which typically triggers market stabilization and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC between GDPC1 growth (from previous quarter) and 20d returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
